limits: Synthetic hourly completed ordinary plans; no city scheduler, travel, physical arrival, social density or peer diffusion.
Stress has initial headroom but later needs approach ceiling and recovery stays near the three-day floor. It does not establish sustained adaptation.
Residual learns tiny deterministic state drift between choice and settlement; lower MSE does not imply better long-term behavior or LLM training.
The residual observer uses sequential per-actor checkpoints; shared runtime still requires durable receipt and CAS persistence.
Opportunity cost is feasible depth-1 on each policy own state, not counterfactual trajectory return.
Role-place prior is a synthetic fixture. Archived real-outcome replay, role.kind hierarchy and production artifact installation remain pending.
Timing samples include concurrent jobs and are not production SLAs. No fresh browser, hardware GPU, live DB or Sites deployment evidence.
H3 reward provenance is next; it can proceed with current LinUCB, without installing failed H2 candidates.
